composition_subtypes.role: Preprocessing: sort problems by descending difficulty for optimal order
Knapsack-like DP minimizing solving time given score and count

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort problems by difficulty desc, then DP optimizes time for each (score, count); finally select best feasible score with training time.
payload.rationale: Sorting ensures efficient order under skill degradation; DP handles knapsack-like selection with multiplicative costs; both mechanisms are essential.
